# IKASLE Technologies

> Software Engineering Company in Coimbatore, India. Engineering custom software, web & mobile applications, ERP platforms, and AI automation for businesses worldwide.

## Overview
IKASLE Technologies is a premier software development and digital engineering partner headquartered in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. We engineer custom enterprise software, scalable SaaS architectures, responsive web platforms, iOS/Android mobile applications, and connected business automation systems for clients across India, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, and global markets.

- **Website**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com
- **Headquarters**: 1639/A, 2nd Floor, Hopes, Peelamedu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India – 641004
- **Phone**: +91 78451 32962
- **Email**: business@ikasle.in
- **Founded**: 2020

## Core Engineering Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development): Tailored line-of-business software, internal tools, microservices, and enterprise systems engineered around unique business workflows.
- [Website Development](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/website-development): High-performance, SEO-optimized, responsive websites and digital platforms built with Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web standards.
- [Web Application Development](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/web-application-development): Scalable SaaS platforms, customer portals, cloud-native dashboards, and interactive web applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform Android and iOS applications with seamless APIs and responsive UX.
- [ERP & Business Automation](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/erp-business-automation): Connected systems integrating inventory, order management, sales, purchasing, and executive business reporting.
- [AI & Intelligent Automation](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/ai-intelligent-solutions): Applied AI workflows, LLM integrations, document intelligence, and automated business operations.
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/ui-ux-product-design): User-centric product design, design systems, design tokens, interactive prototypes, and production UI.

## International Presence & Delivery Hubs
- **Coimbatore, India (HQ & Core Engineering Hub)**: Full-stack product engineering, system architecture, enterprise SaaS, and core labs (IST / UTC+5:30).
- **United Kingdom (International Portfolio)**: Delivered bespoke website development, digital platforms, and European-standard web applications (GMT / BST).
- **United Arab Emirates (International Portfolio)**: Enterprise web applications, cloud systems, and commercial digital solutions (GST / UTC+4).
